name: Sentinel Advanced Care Package
summary: Sentinel Advanced Care Package is an Alliance supply requisition granted by Illiyana Moonblaze in Ashenvale. Offered to proven fighters of the Silverwing Sentinels, it provides essential battlefield rations and medical dressings tailored exclusively for the ongoing clashes in Warsong Gulch. It marks an escalation from basic survival supplies to formalized military logistical support.

sections.title: Logistics in the Canopy
sections.body: The battle for Warsong Gulch is a grueling war of attrition against the Warsong Outriders. To sustain frontline combatants without bleeding dry the civilian stores of Ashenvale, the Silverwing Sentinels maintain strict logistical caches. Illiyana Moonblaze oversees the outfitting of soldiers who have demonstrated steadfast commitment in the field. Those who rise through the ranks receive specialized aid parcels stocked with battlefield provisions, ensuring vanguard forces remain fed and patched up during extended skirmishes beneath the trees.

sections.title: Provisions of the Silverwing
sections.body: The advanced package contains field-dressings and combat rations strictly designated for deployment inside Warsong Gulch. As soldiers deepen their standing with the Sentinels, these supplies shift from occasional commendation gifts into regular quartermaster requisitions. Sustaining warriors on the front lines allows the night elves to maintain constant pressure against orcish logging parties and keep the defilers from gaining uncontested control over the sacred borderlands.

faq.q: What is the Sentinel Advanced Care Package?
faq.answer: It is a military supply bundle granted by Illiyana Moonblaze in Ashenvale to Alliance fighters who have proven their dedication to the Silverwing Sentinels. It contains field bandages and combat rations specifically intended for combat in Warsong Gulch.
Illiyana Moonblaze, the Silverwing supply officer and representative stationed near the entrance to Warsong Gulch in Ashenvale, distributes the package.

faq.q: Why are these supplies restricted to Warsong Gulch?
faq.answer: The provisions are specially enchanted and apportioned military assets designated solely for the defense of the Gulch. The Silverwing Sentinels strictly limit their distribution to ensure their war reserves remain focused on repelling the Warsong Outriders.

faq.q: How does a soldier earn this package?
faq.answer: Fighters must earn standing with the Silverwing Sentinels by battling Horde forces in Warsong Gulch and complete the preliminary standard care package requisition before receiving this upgraded parcel.

faq.q: What happens after receiving this package?
faq.answer: Once you earn sufficient standing with the Sentinels, the items within the package become regularly available for purchase from the Silverwing quartermaster, including combat rations and high-grade battlefield bandages.

faq.q: What is the conflict between the Silverwing Sentinels and the Horde here?
faq.answer: The Silverwing Sentinels fight to protect the sacred forests of Ashenvale from the Warsong clan, whose logging operations aggressively strip the woodland for timber to construct Orgrimmar and fuel the Horde war machine.

angles.text: The defense of Ashenvale relies on joint Alliance mobilization, where volunteers from across the kingdoms stand shoulder-to-shoulder with the night elves against orcish expansion.
The Silverwing Sentinels are fighting on ancestral ground; every ration and bandage delivered preserves the defenders protecting Elune's sacred woods from deforestation.
